answers.core: The ability to run multiple instances is already a core feature, but it is limited by the fact that all 4 instances are identical. There are situations (server-client, A B feature testing, game with pop-out UI, etc) where developers want the instances to behave differently, and command line arguments are a direct way to tell instances how to behave
answers.workaround: As far as I can tell this cannot be achieved without creating a custom scene requiring the user (me) to choose which instance should be a server and which should be a client

title: Separate cmd args per debug instance
